title: Rice and Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Vegetables
subtitle: with miso tahini dressing
description: A big bowl of brown basmati rice and quinoa with roasted carrots, beetroot and cauliflower, toasted pumpkin seeds and parsley, drizzled with a creamy miso tahini dressing.

steps.text: Heat a medium pot with a teaspoon of olive oil and fry the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes until golden. Add the rice and stir until every grain is coated in oil.
Add 2 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon salt and bring to the boil. Lower the heat, cover and cook for about 40 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender. Keep warm.

Meanwhile, put the rinsed quinoa in another pot with 2 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon salt, bring to the boil, lower the heat, cover and cook for 20 minutes until all the liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and keep warm.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes until they start to pop.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Toss the carrots, beetroot wedges and cauliflower florets on a tray with 3 tablespoons olive oil, coarse salt and thyme.
Roast for 30 minutes until the vegetables are cooked but not too soft and still crisp.

Make the dressing: blend the miso, tahini, rice vinegar, sesame oil, maple syrup and 1/2 cup water until thick and creamy, adding more water to reach the desired consistency. Keep in a jar in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.
Mix the rice and quinoa in a large bowl with the roasted vegetables, pumpkin seeds and parsley, drizzle over 1/2 cup of the dressing and serve.
